      A solid performance all around in a hard-fought win in the rain against Silver. QB Jim C made clutch throws, Jay and Captain Jamal made acrobatic plays, and human prediction engine Levert called out an alarming number of Silver’s offensive plays before they happened.

      The play of the game was Sam S making a clutch 4th down catch for Light Blue while getting sandwiched by two Silver defenders, which knocked him out of the game with four broken ribs (!) in the first half of his season debut.

      A rough but heroic way to go out. RIP Sam, 9-9:30am October 4, 2026.

      ![](data:image/jpeg;base64,){: width="624" height="351"}

      One of the great things about our new partner Game Glimpse (pay me, Game Glimpse) is that we now have receipts when absurd things happen at the fields. Like on Sunday, when True Red may have been the first team to ever lose a game because a punt hit the back of their player’s head.

      Alex D was the victim there, getting a concussion and giving Seafoam the ball at Red’s 15 yard line to set up a 27-26 comeback win for the Foamosexual Agenda.

      It’s True Red’s second one-point loss in the past two weeks. I’m not sure what Wyatt has done to upset the football gods since his two straight titles, but maybe he should [purify himself in the waters of Lake Minnetonka](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S38O7MB8Dwk) this weekend.

      A Prince song 4 u: [Little Red Corvette](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v0KpfrJE4zw&amp;pp=ygUacHJpbmNlIGxpdHRsZSByZWQgY29ydmV0dGU%3D)

      Orange gets on the board in a big way, dismantling Black 41-13.
